mainText: Hello, Verona! At 8 AM, here is today's balanced dish. It is 76 degrees with overcast skies near the Reddan Soccer Park, and the air quality is currently moderate with an index of 53.

In city news, the new Tai Chi Animal Frolics sculpture has been installed at Century School Park. This seven-foot tall carving of animals was created by local artists Gene Delcourt and Christian Felland and donated by Gerri Gurman to be a welcoming piece of art for the entire community.

There is plenty to do, including Yoga at Insight Wellness today and Hop Haus Trivia today. Looking ahead, you can enjoy live music at Bailey's Run and Wisconsin Brewing Company tomorrow, followed by the Dane County Farmers' Market this Friday.

In a report from August 30, officers were dispatched to the 800 block of North Edge Trail following reports of a vehicle window being intentionally smashed; the suspect fled the scene and has an active arrest warrant.
If you are craving something sweet, today's flavor is Snickers Swirl. Please note that the store opens today at 10:00 AM so you can stop by and grab a scoop.
